nodes.line: The pit can breathe again./South of the trees stays quiet.
nodes.note: the hollow is quiet and he is back to the fire.

nodes.line: Quiet, then. The band is yours./The hollow can take a fire again.
Still in the pit. South, through/the trees. You will smell the ash.
nodes.note: he has already pointed the way.

nodes.line: Bram. I burn the charcoal./Something has taken the hollow.
nodes.note: a working man, not a rumor.

nodes.line: Good. South, past the inn./Come back when the pit is quiet.
nodes.note: he treats the promise as a job.

nodes.line: Not the sluice. South, through the trees./A hollow under the ash. One boar.
nodes.note: he separates this job from Calder's ditch.

nodes.line: The east road is Pell's worry./This pit will still be here.
